title: TRICARE Retired Reserve Recall Adjustment Relief: Paid and Unpaid Adjustments
content:
Under the TRICARE Premium-Based Plans, for a TRICARE Retired Reserve plan: The daily amount the recall adjustment relief withdraws follows what was paid on the adjustment: where no payment stands against it, it is the amount of the adjustment divided by the days it covers; where a payment covers only part of it, it is the part still unpaid divided by those days; otherwise nothing is withdrawn, the paid adjustment is returned with the recall paid-month credit instead.

The amount of the adjustment is the total of the coverage-type adjustment bills for the most recently paid month, and the days it covers are the total of the days those bills cover; the payment is what is posted against the adjustment bill.

**Hypothetical.** An adjustment of 387.33 covering 14 days: unpaid, 27.6664 a day is withdrawn; with 100.00 paid on it, the unpaid 287.33 divided by 14, 20.5236 a day; paid in full, nothing is withdrawn.
